AcBuild:
(fn AcBuild ()
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings))
  (for i (range (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingPool))
    (bind c (AddComponent|Common|AddStaticMeshComponent :bManualAttachment false :RelativeTransform (Math|Transform|MakeTransform :Location (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X 0.0 :Y 0.0 :Z 0.0))))
    (Components|StaticMesh|SetStaticMesh c (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingMesh))
    (Rendering|Material|SetMaterial c 0 (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingMat))
    (Collision|SetCollisionEnabled c "NoCollision")
    (Rendering|SetCastShadow c false)
    (Transformation|SetMobility c "Movable")
    (Rendering|SetVisibility c false false)
    (Utilities|Array|Add (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings) c))
  (bind s (AddComponent|Common|AddStaticMeshComponent :bManualAttachment false :RelativeTransform (Math|Transform|MakeTransform :Location (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X 0.0 :Y 0.0 :Z 0.0))))
  (Components|StaticMesh|SetStaticMesh s (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellMesh))
  (Rendering|Material|SetMaterial s 0 (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellMat))
  (Collision|SetCollisionEnabled s "NoCollision")
  (Rendering|SetCastShadow s false)
  (Transformation|SetMobility s "Movable")
  (Rendering|SetVisibility s false false)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetShell s)
  (if (Variables|4-Prueba|GetPreviewEmbrace)
    (Transformation|SetWorldLocation s (Math|Transform|TransformLocation (Transformation|GetActorTransform) (Variables|4-Prueba|GetPreviewEye)))
    (Transformation|SetWorldScale3D s (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X (/ (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellRadius) 50.0) :Y (/ (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellRadius) 50.0) :Z (/ (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellRadius) 50.0)))
    (bind (r g b a) (Utilities|Struct|BreakLinearColor (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellColor)))
    (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 s 4 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 r g b (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellGlow)))
    (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 s 0 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellAlpha) 0.0 (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellWobble) (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellVeins)))
    (Rendering|SetVisibility s true false)))
AcBoot:
(fn AcBoot ()
  (bind n (Utilities|Array|Length (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings)))
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAge))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAge) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRRad))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRRad) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRHit))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRHit) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRKind))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRKind) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVoice))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVoice) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVel))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVel) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRFired))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRFired) n)
  (Utilities|Array|Clear (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAlive))
  (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAlive) n)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetProgress 0.0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetShown 0.0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetPulse 0.0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetNextRing 0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetCalls 0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetStageDone false)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmbrace 0.0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmbracing false)
  (Rendering|SetVisibility (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) false false)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetNextDebug (+ (Utilities|Time|GetGameTimeinSeconds) 2.0))
  (CallFunction|AcBootVoice)
  (CallFunction|AcBootHarp)
  (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)
    (:"Is Valid"
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetBaseEdge (Class|BPProtoSoulSC|GetEdgeIntensity (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba))))
    (:"Is Not Valid")))
AcBootVoice:
(fn AcBootVoice ()
  (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetVoice)
    (:"Is Valid"
      (Actor|Tick|AddTickPrerequisiteActor (Variables|0-Enlace|GetVoice) self)
      (Actor|Tick|SetActorTickEnabled (Variables|0-Enlace|GetVoice) false)
      (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame (Variables|0-Enlace|GetVoice) true))
    (:"Is Not Valid")))
AcTick:
(fn AcTick (Dt)
  (CallFunction|AcBootVoice)
  (CallFunction|AcDebug)
  (CallFunction|AcAmoeba :Dt Dt)
  (bind cm (Game|GetPlayerCameraManager 0))
  (Utilities|IsValid cm
    (:"Is Valid"
      (bind eye (Camera|GetCameraLocation cm))
      (for i (range (Utilities|Array|Length (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings)))
        (if (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAlive) i)
          (CallFunction|AcRingStep :I i :Dt Dt :Eye eye)))
      (CallFunction|AcEmbrace :Dt Dt :Eye eye)
      (CallFunction|AcSense))
    (:"Is Not Valid")))
AcSense:
(fn AcSense ()
  (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp)
    (:"Is Valid"
      (bind lp (Class|BPHarpSC|GetLastPluck (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp)))
      (Utilities|Array|Resize (Variables|Z-Estado|GetSeen) (Utilities|Array|Length lp))
      (for i (range (Utilities|Array|Length lp))
        (bind v (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) lp i))
        (if (> v (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetSeen) i))
          (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetSeen) i v)
          (CallFunction|AcCall :V i :Vel (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Class|BPHarpSC|GetEnergy (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp)) i)))))
    (:"Is Not Valid")))
AcCall:
(fn AcCall (V Vel)
  (bind hl (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp)))
  (CallFunction|AcRing :Kind (- 1 1) :V V :Vel Vel :Origin (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X (.x hl) :Y (.y hl) :Z (+ (.z (Transformation|GetActorLocation)) (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingZ))) :Col (Class|BPHarpSC|NoteColor :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp) :I V)))
AcRing:
(fn AcRing (Kind V Vel Origin Col)
  (bind i (Variables|Z-Estado|GetNextRing))
  (bind c (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings) i))
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAge) i 0.0)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRRad) i 0.0)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRHit) i 0.0)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRKind) i Kind)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVoice) i V)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVel) i Vel)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRFired) i false)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAlive) i true)
  (Transformation|SetWorldLocation c Origin)
  (bind (r g b a) (Utilities|Struct|BreakLinearColor Col))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 c 4 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 r g b (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingGlow)))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 c 0 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 0.0 (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingWidth) 0.0 (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingSoft)))
  (Rendering|SetVisibility c true false)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetNextRing (select (>= (+ i 1) (Utilities|Array|Length (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings))) 0 (+ i 1))))
AcRingStep:
(fn AcRingStep (I Dt Eye)
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAge) I (+ (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAge) I) Dt))
  (bind rad (* (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAge) I) (Variables|1-Onda|GetWaveSpeed)))
  (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRRad) I rad)
  (bind c (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRings) I))
  (bind kind (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRKind) I))
  (bind tgt (select (== kind 0) (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)) Eye))
  (bind dist (Math|Vector|Distance2D(Vector) (Transformation|GetWorldLocation c) tgt))
  (bind fired (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRFired) I))
  (bind after (select fired (Math|Float|Clamp(Float) (- 1.0 (/ (- rad (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRHit) I)) (* (Variables|1-Onda|GetWaveSpeed) (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingAfter))))) 1.0))
  (bind alpha (* (* (select (== kind 0) (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingAlpha) (Variables|1-Onda|GetReturnAlpha)) (Math|Float|Exp (/ (neg rad) (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingFade)))) after))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 c 0 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 rad (+ (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingWidth) (* rad (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingWidthGrow))) alpha (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingSoft)))
  (if (and (not fired) (>= rad dist))
    (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRFired) I true)
    (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRHit) I rad)
    (CallFunction|AcArrive :I I)
    (elif (and fired (<= after 0.0))
      (Utilities|Array|SetArrayElem (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRAlive) I false)
      (Rendering|SetVisibility c false false))))
AcArrive:
(fn AcArrive (I)
  (bind v (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVoice) I))
  (bind vel (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRVel) I))
  (if (== (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetRKind) I) 0)
    (CallFunction|AcAnswer :V v :Vel vel)
    (else
      (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetVoice)
        (:"Is Valid"
          (Class|BPHarpSC|Pluck :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetVoice) :I v :Speed (* (+ (Variables|3-Voz|GetVoiceSpeedFar) (* (- (Variables|3-Voz|GetVoiceSpeedNear) (Variables|3-Voz|GetVoiceSpeedFar)) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShown))) (+ 0.6 (* 0.4 vel))) :Right (Variables|3-Voz|GetVoiceRight)))
        (:"Is Not Valid")))))
AcAnswer:
(fn AcAnswer (V Vel)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetPulse 1.0)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetCalls (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetCalls) 1))
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetProgress (Math|Float|Min(Float) 1.0 (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetProgress) (* (Variables|2-Ameba|GetStepPerCall) (+ (- 1.0 (Variables|2-Ameba|GetStepVelGain)) (* (Variables|2-Ameba|GetStepVelGain) Vel))))))
  (bind al (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)))
  (CallFunction|AcRing :Kind (- 2 1) :V V :Vel Vel :Origin (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X (.x al) :Y (.y al) :Z (+ (.z (Transformation|GetActorLocation)) (Variables|1-Onda|GetRingZ))) :Col (Class|BPHarpSC|NoteColor :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetHarp) :I V)))
AcAmoeba:
(fn AcAmoeba (Dt)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetProgress (Math|Float|Min(Float) 1.0 (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetProgress) (* (Variables|2-Ameba|GetDrift) Dt))))
  (bind rem (Math|Float|Max(Float) (- (Variables|Z-Estado|GetProgress) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShown)) 0.0))
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetShown (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShown) (Math|Float|Min(Float) rem (* Dt (Math|Float|Max(Float) (Variables|2-Ameba|GetBrakeFloor) (* (Variables|2-Ameba|GetBrake) (Math|Float|Sqrt rem)))))))
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetPulse (Math|Float|Max(Float) 0.0 (- (Variables|Z-Estado|GetPulse) (/ Dt (Variables|2-Ameba|GetGlowDecay)))))
  (Utilities|IsValid (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)
    (:"Is Valid"
      (bind xf (Transformation|GetActorTransform))
      (bind e (* (* (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbrace) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbrace)) (- 3.0 (* 2.0 (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbrace)))))
      (Transformation|SetActorLocation :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba) :NewLocation (Math|Vector|Lerp(Vector) (Math|Vector|Lerp(Vector) (Math|Transform|TransformLocation xf (Variables|2-Ameba|GetFarPoint)) (Math|Transform|TransformLocation xf (Variables|2-Ameba|GetNearPoint)) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShown)) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbraceEye) e))
      (Class|BPProtoSoulSC|SetSize :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba) :Size (+ (Variables|2-Ameba|GetAmoebaSize) (* (- (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetEmbraceSize) (Variables|2-Ameba|GetAmoebaSize)) e)))
      (Class|BPProtoSoulSC|SetEdgeIntensity :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba) :EdgeIntensity (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetBaseEdge) (* (- (Variables|2-Ameba|GetGlowPeak) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetBaseEdge)) (* (Variables|Z-Estado|GetPulse) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetPulse))))))
    (:"Is Not Valid")))
AcEmbrace:
(fn AcEmbrace (Dt Eye)
  (if (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbracing)
    (CallFunction|AcEmbraceStep :Dt Dt)
    (elif (>= (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShown) 0.999)
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmbracing true)
      (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmbraceEye Eye)
      (Transformation|SetWorldLocation (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) Eye)
      (Transformation|SetWorldScale3D (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) (Math|Vector|MakeVector :X (/ (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellRadius) 50.0) :Y (/ (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellRadius) 50.0) :Z (/ (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellRadius) 50.0)))
      (bind (r g b a) (Utilities|Struct|BreakLinearColor (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellColor)))
      (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) 4 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 r g b (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellGlow)))
      (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) 0 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 0.0 0.0 (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellWobble) (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellVeins)))
      (Rendering|SetVisibility (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) true false)
      (Development|PrintString "ATTRACT embrace starts" false))))
AcEmbraceStep:
(fn AcEmbraceStep (Dt)
  (Variables|Z-Estado|SetEmbrace (Math|Float|Min(Float) 1.0 (+ (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbrace) (/ Dt (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetEmbraceTime)))))
  (bind inside (- (* 50.0 (Class|BPProtoSoulSC|GetSize (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba))) (Math|Vector|Distance(Vector) (Transformation|GetActorLocation :self (Variables|0-Enlace|GetAmoeba)) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbraceEye))))
  (Rendering|Material|SetCustomPrimitiveDataVector4 (Variables|Z-Estado|GetShell) 0 (Math|Vector4|MakeVector4 (* (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellAlpha) (Math|Float|Clamp(Float) (/ (+ inside 20.0) 60.0))) (Variables|Z-Estado|GetPulse) (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellWobble) (Variables|5-Abrazo|GetShellVeins)))
  (if (and (>= (Variables|Z-Estado|GetEmbrace) 1.0) (not (Variables|Z-Estado|GetStageDone)))
    (Variables|Z-Estado|SetStageDone true)
    (Development|PrintString "ATTRACT stage done (embraced)" false)))
